correctness.rationale: Dirichlet(1,...,1) circular spacings give exact first two vacant-length moments by tail integration. Explicit Var(U)=[2(1-s)^{n+1}+(n-1)(1-2s)_+^{n+1}]/(n+1)-(1-s)^{2n}, and Cov(B,U)=-(1/2)Var'(s). For s<1/2, define F_n=n(1-s)^{n-1}-(n-1)((1-2s)/(1-s))^n. F_n' has sign of R_n-1 where R_n=(1-2s)^{n-1}/(1-s)^{2n-1}; log R_n' has unique sign switch at s=1/(2n), so F_n increases then decreases and crosses 1 once for n>=3. n=2 crosses at 1/2. The root expansion from h(c)=e^-c-(1+c+c²)e^-2c, h'(c_*)≠0 and j(c) gives the claimed correction. Independent scalar root checks for n=2,3,4,8,20,100 confirmed uniqueness locally, not its all-n proof.
